name: Env Doctor
description: Diagnose the local dev machine, classify each failure into a fault domain (infra/toolchain/secrets/project — the manifest's four sections), auto-fix the safe ones with apc env up, and fingerprint. Keeps environment faults out of SUT verdicts.

sampleTasks.title: Diagnose the machine, classify failures, up, fingerprint
sampleTasks.prompt:
Run env-doctor on this machine. The `apc` CLI is NOT on PATH — invoke it as `npx tsx sdk/apc/bin/apc.ts <subcommand>` from the repo root (its stdout is pure JSON). Steps: (1) `npx tsx sdk/apc/bin/apc.ts env doctor` and read the stdout JSON (per-item {item,section,status,detail,fixHint} plus top-level summary{pass,fail,skip,total} and failed[]); (2) classify every failing check into its fault domain using the item's `section` field (infra / toolchain / secrets / project); (3) `npx tsx sdk/apc/bin/apc.ts env up --safe` to bring up the auto-fixable lightweight items — you MUST pass --safe: never run bare `apc env up`, its docker step runs `colima start` which blocks for minutes in this non-interactive context; heavy steps landing in manual[] is expected; (4) `npx tsx sdk/apc/bin/apc.ts env fingerprint`. Report the doctor exit code (0 or 78), the per-item pass/fail counts (summary), and the fault-domain classification of every failing item. secrets-domain reds are never auto-fixed — report their fixHint only.

--- YOUR REPORT MUST USE THIS MACHINE-CHECKED OUTPUT CONTRACT. The checker looks for EACH ITEM'S OWN KEYED LINE and re-reads every `path:line` off disk, so a summary count no longer stands in for a per-item report, and an invented citation is caught.

Every manifest item gets ONE line, keyed by its exact item id, carrying: its real observed status, its fault domain, and the line in `sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts` that DECLARES that item (get it with `rg -n "id: 'toolchain.node'" sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts` — do NOT guess line numbers):
```
- infra.docker-daemon: pass | domain=infra | sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts:165
- infra.mysql-3307: pass | domain=infra | sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts:178
- toolchain.node: fail | domain=toolchain | node 23.9.0 major 23 != pin 20 | fixHint: nvm use 20 | sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts:318
- toolchain.hermes-gateway-models: skip | domain=toolchain | 未检测（无凭据）| sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts:408
…（21 个固定 item 一个都不能少；`infra.kind-<cluster>` 的 id 随 CLUSTER_NAME 变，也要在表里但不进机器判据）
```
Then the four fault-domain roll-ups, each on its own keyed line, citing that section's declaration block in the manifest:
```
- domain-infra: 7 项 → pass 7 / fail 0 / skip 0 | sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts:163
- domain-toolchain: 7 项 → pass 5 / fail 1 / skip 1 | sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts:316
- domain-secrets: 2 项 → pass 1 / fail 1（凭据永不自动修，只出 fixHint）| sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts:447
- domain-project: 6 项 → pass 5 / fail 1 | sdk/apc/env/manifest.ts:569
```
Rules the checker enforces: every keyed line's value must carry at least one repo-root-relative `path:line` that resolves on disk (real file, line in range, non-blank), or be an explicit `N/A — <reason ≥20 chars>`; do NOT open a value with `无` or `N/A` for a real item — start it with the real status (`pass`/`fail`/`skip`). A `rg -c` HIT COUNT is not a line number; write counts as `count=N`. Then give the doctor exit code (0 or 78), the `summary{pass,fail,skip,total}` readback proving total == pass+fail+skip == items.length, the `apc env up --safe` exit code + manual[], and the fingerprint JSON.
expectedArtifacts: one keyed line per manifest item {item id: status | domain | manifest.ts:<declaring line>} — 21 fixed items, none silently dropped
apc env doctor stdout JSON (per-item {item,section,status,detail,fixHint}; top-level summary/failed[])
four fault-domain roll-up lines (domain-infra/toolchain/secrets/project), each citing that section's manifest block
apc env up exit code + idempotent second-run all-skip evidence

acceptanceCriteria.label: every manifest item answered on its own keyed line, each citing the manifest line that declares it (re-verified on disk) — a summary count no longer stands in for a per-item report
all four fault domains rolled up on their own keyed line (infra/toolchain/secrets/project), each citing the manifest section it summarizes

doctor 的退出码与逐项计数取自产物、不取自叙述 —— 报告贴出 `apc env doctor` 的原始 JSON，checker 重解析：DOCTOR-EXIT/PASS/FAIL/SKIP/TOTAL 五行必须逐字等于产物字段；exitCode 只允许 0|78（其它值=doctor 自己崩了）；78 必须伴随 envStatus=env_blocked；判绿必须 failed 为空；DOCTOR-FAILED-IDS/UNDETECTED-IDS 必须逐字列出产物里的真实 id 集合（把某项 fail 写成 pass 就会与该清单冲突）
doctor exit code is 0 or 78 (never a crash)

humanApprovalRequiredFor: supplying secrets-domain keys (SKILL_CONFIG_ENC_KEY / IDENTITY_KMS_KEY etc.) — never auto-filled
